title: 3.7 Money: profit, loss, discount, commission and bills

q.Q1: Q1. A trader buys a crate of tomatoes for KSh 2 400 and sells it for KSh 3 000. Find the profit and the percentage profit.

q.Q2: Q2. A phone bought for KSh 8 000 is sold for KSh 6 800. Find the percentage loss.

q.Q3: Q3. An agent earns 4% commission on sales of KSh 350 000. Find the commission.
q.Q4: Q4. A dress marked KSh 3 200 is sold at a 15% discount. Find the selling price.

q.Q5: Q5. Prepare a bill for: 4 kg rice at KSh 180, 2 litres of milk at KSh 60, 5 eggs at KSh 15. Find the total.

q.Q6: Q6. They spend 30% on food, 25% on rent, 10% on transport and save the rest. How much do they save?

q.Exit ticket: Exit ticket. What is the profit if goods bought for KSh 500 are sold for KSh 650?
